title: Mesh LLM: distributed AI computing on iroh
summary: Mesh LLM is a distributed AI computing framework built on iroh's peer-to-peer networking capabilities, enabling decentralized LLM inference across a mesh of connected nodes without relying on centralized cloud infrastructure.
problem_solved: Enables distributed AI inference across peer-to-peer nodes, reducing dependency on centralized cloud providers for LLM workloads.
why_valuable: Provides privacy, resilience, and cost-efficiency by leveraging mesh networking to distribute AI computational workloads across multiple participants.
